tabAndShiftTabMove: Tab and Shift+Tab move through the items in reading order, a frame’s items right after it; Alt+arrow keys jump to the nearest item in that direction. Enter edits the selected item, arrow keys move it and Alt+Shift+arrow keys resize it. Shift+F10 opens its menu, Alt+F10 the format toolbar, F6 moves between the canvas and the toolbars. With a creation tool picked, Enter places a new item next to the selection. Alt+Shift+L lists the board as text.
